map.含空格、#、$ 或引号的值必须加引号，否则会被截断或触发变量展开。多数解析器支持: A value containing a space, #, $ or a quote must be quoted, otherwise it is truncated or triggers variable expansion. Most parsers support single quotes (no expansion) and double quotes (expansion). The safe habit is to quote everything with double quotes and avoid $ and backticks inside values — some parsers interpret them as variables or commands.
